purpose: 5V DC fan accessory distribution and protected-output-present LED; physical prototype

input.supply: External isolated regulated 5V DC supply, current-limited to 1A maximum

fan.note: Output is below 5V due to series diode and PTC. Measure loaded voltage and verify selected brushless fan startup range. Prefer <=0.3A running fan, confirm startup peak <=0.5A.

assembly.D1: Cathode band at pad2 toward J2
assembly.D2: Anode long lead at pad1; cathode flat side/short lead pad2
